scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi, I recently applied for a conventional loan for home improvement in the amount of $95,000 with a 180-month term. Can you please tell me the current status or outcome of my application? Was it approved, denied, or is it still pending?
dialogue.agent: Your loan application was approved and the loan has been originated.

dialogue.user: Thank you for letting me know that my application was approved! Could you please tell me what my interest rate is and what the total loan costs will be?
dialogue.agent: Your interest rate is 7.375%. The total loan costs are $517.47.

dialogue.user: Thanks for providing that information. Just to confirm, is my loan classified as a high-cost (HOEPA) mortgage or does it include any negative amortization features? Also, has my loan been transferred or sold to another institution yet?
dialogue.agent: Your loan is not classified as a high-cost (HOEPA) mortgage, and it does not include any negative amortization features. The record also shows that your loan has not been transferred or sold to another institution.

dialogue.user: Thank you, that's very helpful and reassuring! One last question: can you tell me what my debt-to-income ratio means for my loan application? Was this a concern at all in the approval process?
dialogue.agent: Your debt-to-income (DTI) ratio for the application was between 20% and less than 30%. This means that your total monthly debt payments, including the new loan, are between 20% and 30% of your total monthly income. The loan record does not include information about how your DTI may have affected the approval decision or if it was a concern during the process.

dialogue.user:
Thank you, I appreciate your clear explanations and quick responses. I feel well informed about my loan approval, interest rate, and the other details I asked about. All of my questions were answered clearly, and I feel confident about the process.

<Very Satisfied>

The agent was knowledgeable, respectful, and answered everything in plain language. I feel very comfortable moving forward. Thanks again!
